_meta.description: 20 one-sentence NL descriptions: 10 'detailed' (information-dense, structured) + 10 'vague' (realistic user-level). The split lets us isolate Optimizer impact: with rich input, Discoverer already produces near-optimal spec → Optimizer has no room; with vague input, Discoverer must INFER parameters/types/units → those inferences are where Optimizer adds value.
_meta.convention: id is the expected tool name + optional style suffix. style is 'detailed' or 'vague'.

tools.description: Compute body mass index (BMI) given a person's weight in kilograms and height in meters.
Convert a DNA sequence to its corresponding RNA sequence by transcribing thymine (T) to uracil (U).

Search ClinicalTrials.gov for trials studying a specific medical condition, returning trial IDs, titles, and recruitment status.
Fetch detailed compound information from PubChem given a PubChem Compound ID (CID) number, including SMILES, molecular formula, and synonyms.
Compute the two-tailed p-value for an independent two-sample t-test given two arrays of numeric measurements, with optional Welch correction for unequal variances.
Retrieve protein 3D structure metadata from the RCSB Protein Data Bank by 4-character PDB ID, including resolution, experimental method, and chain composition.
Search PubMed for biomedical articles with optional filters for publication year range, journal name, and author last name, returning ranked article metadata.
Search DrugBank for drugs that act on a specific protein target, given the target's gene symbol or UniProt accession, returning drug names and mechanisms.
Search DrugBank for drugs approved or commonly prescribed for a specific medical indication (disease or condition name), returning drug names and approval status.
